SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT BUYER , PO_NO , PO_SEQ , DS_SEQ FROM ICOMPORS WHERE BUYER IN ( 'KRHYOS0033','KRHYOS0034','KRHYOS0036','KRHYOS0037','KRHYOS0043') AND SEND_FLAG = 'N' AND ADD_DATE > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-5,'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY BUYER, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, DS_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO , PODT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ , PORS.DS_SEQ , PORS.DS_DATE , PORS.CD_QTY AS DS_QTY , PORS.ADD_DATE , PORS.STATUS FROM ICOMPORS PORS, ICOMPODT PODT WHERE PORS.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND PORS.PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PORS.PO_SEQ= '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND PORS.DS_SEQ= '$G_RS.DS_SEQ$' AND PORS.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PORS.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PORS.PO_SEQ= PODT.PO_SEQ AND NVL(TRIM(PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO), ' ') NOT LIKE '%_D' AND NVL(TRIM(PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO), ' ') NOT LIKE 'P%'
UPDATE ICOMPORS SET SEND_FLAG = 'Y' , SEND_DATE = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , SEND_TIME = to_char(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND DS_SEQ = '$G_RS.DS_SEQ$'
UPDATE ICOMPORS SET SEND_FLAG = 'E' , SEND_DATE = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , SEND_TIME = to_char(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND PO_SEQ = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' AND DS_SEQ = '$G_RS.DS_SEQ$'
